screen.title: Print Center: New Printing Credits
text: Starting March 1, every student will receive 200 free printing credits per semester on their student ID card. One black-and-white page uses one credit, and a color page uses five. Unused credits do not carry over to the next semester. Additional credits can be purchased at the front desk or online through the student portal.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the notice?
options: To explain a new way students will pay for printing
To announce that the print center will close in March
To remind students to renew their ID cards
To advertise a sale on color printers

why.en: Main purpose (paraphrase): a new credit system for printing. C and D reuse words from the notice (ID card, color) with a different meaning.
why.tr: Ana amaç (parafraz): baskı için yeni kredi sistemi. C ve D metindeki kelimeleri (ID card, color) farklı anlamda kullanıyor.

questions.stem: What is true about credits that are not used?
options: They can be exchanged for cash at the front desk
They expire at the end of each term
They are added to the next semester's total
They can be used only for color pages

why.en: Paraphrase: "do not carry over to the next semester" = they expire. C says the opposite; A borrows "front desk".
why.tr: Parafraz: "do not carry over" = dönem sonunda geçersiz olur. C tam tersini söylüyor; A "front desk" ifadesini ödünç alıyor.
